content.title: Drawing Becomes Complete | Tool Contact, Line Growth, Colored Artwork Proof
content.summary: A graphite hand constructs and colors an adult gardener from blank paper to held artwork. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: The real drawing tool is visible before the subject exists. + Every new contour grows from the current tool contact. + Objects are constructed through spatially related lines. + Color fills only established closed shapes. + The tool leaves before the completed artwork holds.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show one adult book artist's hand and graphite pencil above blank cream paper. Extend the same line into the tray, sprouts and one pouring can so their contact relation is clear. Lift the pencil completely and hold the finished original garden illustration without further motion.
